==> /etc/falak/db/postgresql.conf (-rw-r--r--)
# Rendered by falak-db at every container start: do not edit, changes are lost.
# Memory limit: 1024 MiB

listen_addresses = '*'
port = 5432
max_connections = 100
unix_socket_directories = '/var/run/postgresql'
hba_file = '/etc/falak/db/pg_hba.conf'
password_encryption = 'scram-sha-256'

shared_buffers = 256MB
effective_cache_size = 768MB
work_mem = 4MB
maintenance_work_mem = 64MB
dynamic_shared_memory_type = posix

# Point-in-time recovery: every WAL segment is spooled; the agent ships the spool.
wal_level = replica
archive_mode = on
archive_command = 'falak-db wal-push %p'
archive_timeout = 60
max_wal_senders = 10

ssl = on
ssl_cert_file = '/etc/falak/db/tls/server.crt'
ssl_key_file = '/etc/falak/db/tls/server.key'
ssl_ca_file = '/etc/falak/db/tls/ca.crt'
ssl_min_protocol_version = 'TLSv1.2'

log_destination = 'stderr'
logging_collector = off
log_min_duration_statement = 1000
log_line_prefix = '%m [%p] %q%u@%d '
# No query text or bind values in the log beyond the slow statements (normalized by the agent).
log_parameter_max_length = 0
log_parameter_max_length_on_error = 0
log_min_error_statement = panic
log_timezone = 'UTC'
timezone = 'UTC'
datestyle = 'iso, mdy'
default_text_search_config = 'pg_catalog.english'

# Written by `falak-db recover` into a restored data directory.
include_if_exists = '/var/lib/postgresql/data/falak-recovery.conf'
==> /etc/falak/db/pg_hba.conf (-rw-r--r--)
# Rendered by falak-db at every container start: do not edit, changes are lost.
# Inside the container: trusted (the socket is not shared). Over TCP: SCRAM passwords.
local   all          all                 trust
local   replication  all                 trust
host    all          all  127.0.0.1/32   scram-sha-256
host    all          all  ::1/128        scram-sha-256
host    all          all  all            scram-sha-256
==> tuning
effective_cache_size = 768MB
maintenance_work_mem = 64MB
max_connections = 100
memory_mb = 1024
shared_buffers = 256MB
work_mem = 4MB
